criteria.statement: `readBlockingPolicy` reads a `## 5c. Blocking policy` section of `verification.md` and returns `{ policy: 'must-pass', status: 'declared' }` for the line `Blocking: must-pass only` and `{ policy: 'all', status: 'declared' }` for `Blocking: all criteria`, each with the line as `raw`
criteria.evidence: Jest transcript from `packages/core/lib/functional-verification.test.js` showing passing cases for both declared values, the asserted return objects visible in the test source or output

criteria.statement: When the `## 5c. Blocking policy` heading is absent, the `Blocking:` line is absent, or `verification.md` does not exist, `readBlockingPolicy` returns `policy: 'all'` with `status: 'absent'`
criteria.evidence: Jest transcript showing passing cases for each of the three absent shapes (no heading, heading with no line, missing file)

criteria.statement: Any `Blocking:` value other than the two allowed ones, or a section holding two `Blocking:` lines, makes `readBlockingPolicy` return `status: 'invalid'` (`policy: null`)
criteria.evidence: Jest transcript showing passing cases for an unrecognised value and for a duplicated `Blocking:` line, each asserting `status: 'invalid'`

criteria.statement: An invalid blocking value stops verification before the verify-functional workflow is dispatched, and the stop message names the offending line
criteria.evidence: Headless fixture run with `Blocking: <unrecognised value>` in the slot's `verification.md`: transcript showing the stop message quoting that line and no workflow dispatch / no new verification state file written; or a test transcript asserting the same

criteria.statement: Under `Blocking: must-pass only`, with at least one criterion marked must-pass, a run whose only open failures after the inner loop is done (it would exit `stalled` or `stuck`) and the closing regression pass has run are on criteria not marked must-pass, and which has no `unbuilt` criterion, ends `satisfied`
criteria.evidence: Jest transcript from `packages/core/workflows/verify-functional.test.js` for a run with an open non-must-pass `not_met` ending `satisfied`; plus the headless fixture scenario's state file showing outcome `satisfied` alongside a non-must-pass `not_met` criterion

criteria.statement: The policy takes effect only once the inner loop is done: while the loop is still iterating, a `build-defect` failure on a non-must-pass criterion is still handed to Debug and still re-checked by the closing regression pass, rather than being waved through early
criteria.evidence: Test transcript (or fixture state file) showing a non-must-pass `not_met` gap present in a Debug pass's gap list in an iteration before the exit, and the converted outcome applied only at exit after the regression record

criteria.statement: A run converted under the must-pass policy carries `nonBlocking: [{ id, reason }]` — one entry per converted failure — in the workflow's result, in the state file and in the report
criteria.evidence: Fixture run's state file and rendered report each containing `nonBlocking` with the converted criterion's id; test transcript asserting the result object's `nonBlocking`

criteria.statement: Each `nonBlocking` entry is written to `discovered.jsonl` as a product follow-up row
criteria.evidence: The fixture run's `discovered.jsonl` holding one row per `nonBlocking` id, marked as a product follow-up that does not block the feature; or a test transcript asserting the written row

criteria.statement: Under `Blocking: must-pass only`, a run that has any `unbuilt` criterion is not converted to `satisfied`
criteria.evidence: Test transcript for a must-pass-policy run with one `unbuilt` criterion and otherwise only non-must-pass failures, asserting the outcome is not `satisfied` and no `nonBlocking` conversion occurs

criteria.statement: Under `Blocking: must-pass only` with no criterion marked must-pass (a sweep file, or a TRD with none marked), a failure on any criterion still keeps the run from `satisfied`, exactly as today
criteria.evidence: Test transcript for a must-pass-policy run with zero must-pass marks and one open `not_met`, asserting outcome `stalled` or `stuck` and no `nonBlocking` key

criteria.statement: A `satisfied` reached by conversion is still subject to the coverage floor (below it the run reports `insufficient-coverage`) and to the must-pass recheck (an unproven must-pass criterion or uncovered must-pass objective yields `must-pass-unproven`), exactly as for any other `satisfied`
criteria.evidence: Test transcripts for two converted runs: one below the coverage floor ending `insufficient-coverage`, one with a must-pass criterion `not_verifiable` (or an uncovered must-pass objective) ending `must-pass-unproven`

criteria.statement: A failure on a criterion marked must-pass is never converted: a run with an open must-pass `not_met` does not end `satisfied` under `Blocking: must-pass only`, nor under `Blocking: all criteria`
criteria.evidence: Test transcripts under each setting for a run with one open must-pass `not_met`, asserting the outcome is not `satisfied` and the must-pass criterion is absent from any `nonBlocking` list

criteria.statement: Under `Blocking: all criteria`, or with no blocking setting at all, any open `not_met` that is not a settled evidence gap keeps the run from `satisfied`, and the run exits `stalled` or `stuck` exactly as today
criteria.evidence: Test transcripts for a non-must-pass open `not_met` under `Blocking: all criteria` and under an absent section, each ending `stalled` or `stuck`; existing pre-change test cases still passing

criteria.statement: Under `Blocking: all criteria`, or with no setting, no new key appears: the state file, the report and `decideNext`'s return carry no `nonBlocking` (or other policy) key
criteria.evidence: Test transcript asserting `decideNext`'s return keys are unchanged under `all`; a fixture state file and report from a run with no setting containing no `nonBlocking` string

criteria.statement: `/verify-build`'s fix rounds treat a failure the run listed as non-blocking as not buildable: it produces no failing discovery row and is not counted in `buildableOpen`
criteria.evidence: Test transcript (or fixture fix-round output) for a state file holding one `nonBlocking` entry, showing `buildableOpen` excludes it and no failing discovery row is written for its id

criteria.statement: Authoring guidance carries the four-part definition of a material failure: main user flow broken; data lost or corrupted; private data exposed; money or AI spend charged wrongly
criteria.evidence: Grep transcript over the authoring guidance showing each of the four parts' wording

criteria.statement: No prompt asks the Judge to rate a failure (no severity or materiality rating is requested of the Judge)
criteria.evidence: Grep transcript over the Judge prompt sources for the four-part definition and for severity/material/rate wording, with its output showing no match in any Judge prompt
